tabs.heading: How It Works

tabs.heading: Who It's For

tabs.heading: Shipping Information

faq.a: If you're not happy with your Strike Beam set, contact us within 30 days of delivery and we'll help you through the return process.
Each set includes 1 infrared sentry turret, 2 infrared blasters (red and blue), and 3 squad wristbands (white, blue, red).

faq.q: How do I set it up?
faq.a: Power on the turret and both blasters, pick a game mode, and you're ready to battle. No app, pairing, or screen required.
Yes — Strike Beam is built for multiplayer. Each blaster has its own color and hit detection, so two or more players can battle at once.
We offer free standard shipping, with delivery in 14–24 days after your order is dispatched (processing takes 2–4 business days).

faq.q: How does the hit detection work?
faq.a: Each blaster and the sentry turret use infrared sensors with real long-range targeting — land a hit and you'll get instant light and sound feedback.
